paraphrase: The Way is fundamentally complete and pervades everywhere — why depend on practice and realization? Yet if there is the slightest gap, heaven and earth are far apart; even the Buddha sat six years and Bodhidharma nine years facing the wall.
speaker: Dōgen

paraphrase: Sit in full or half lotus with the body upright, the left hand on the right in the cosmic mudrā, eyes open, breath passing gently through the nose; think of not-thinking — how? — non-thinking: this is the essential art of zazen. Zazen is not learning meditation; it is the Dharma gate of ease and joy.
